svg.title: Thai Max Nguyen
svg.desc: I build the wallet inside the chat app Vietnam lives on. Thai Max Nguyen, Senior Product Manager at Zalopay. Led the team behind login and identity, now owns Buy Now Pay Later. Open to product roles in Singapore.
svg.text: THAI MAX NGUYEN · SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER, ZALOPAY

g.text: the chat app Vietnam lives on.

svg.text: Zalopay lives inside Zalo. At Zalopay people call me the firefighter.
The rule is not the obstacle. It is the rail.
Next station: Singapore. Please mind the platform gap.
